g.text: Hyperelliptic carriers: a stronger obstruction
ECC2K-130 • round05 • 2026-11-23 • written, unsigned deductions
Genus130: excluded for the entire isogeny class
A predicts 2 points over F4.
Every hyperelliptic curve over F2 has at least 3.
Each of the three rational P1 fibers has support over F4.
Genus131: four elliptic complements excluded
Trace ±2: 2 F4-points, violating the same lower bound.
Trace +1: 19 F8-points, exceeding the degree2 upper bound18.
Trace 0: 131 branch points form one orbit, forcing 131 | (g+1).
No maximal-order, integral-symmetry or map-degree assumption.
Trace -1: one necessary class remains
Ordinary; branch orbits131+1; J(C) isogenous to A × E0.
y²+y = x+b+R(x)/Q(x), Q irreducible degree131
Necessary normal form. Its required Weil polynomial remains unconstructed.
Fixed sparse curve: rejected in degree6
Q=x^131+x^13+x²+x+1, R=1, b=0: 53 points instead of65.
The first five matching counts do not establish the carrier condition.
General curve/map question remains open.
Nonhyperelliptic genus130 and larger carriers are outside this exclusion.
Sources: REPORT.md, check.cpp/check.txt; Borodin–May2508.16886 §2.1;
Elkin–Pries, Algebra and Number Theory7(2013), §1. No performance claim.
